name: Ergonomics and Human Factors
description: Introduction to ergonomics and human factors; good and bad designs; anthropometry; human errors, accidents and safety; design of displays – visual, auditory, tactile/haptic, and olfactory; design of hand tools and devices; design of controls; human control of systems; usability and user-centered design.
